question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Troublesome
solution:
The correct answer is: Obedient.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Troublesome"** means causing difficulty or annoyance; it refers to something or someone that is hard to deal with or manage. (परेशान करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The **troublesome **child was always causing disruptions in class.
 
 
 
• **"Obedient"** refers to someone who is willing to comply with orders or requests; it is the opposite of troublesome as it indicates a person who is easy to manage and does not cause difficulties. (आज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example: **The **obedient **dog followed all the commands given by its owner.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'troublesome'** is **'obedient'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Soulful** (आत्मीय): Expressing deep feelings, often of sadness or love.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **soulful **singing moved everyone in the audience.
 
 
 
• **Planless** (योजना रहित): Lacking a plan or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** His **planless **approach to the project led to confusion and delays.
 
 
 
• **Curious** (जिज्ञासु): Eager to know or learn something.
 
 
• **Example:** The **curious **child kept asking questions about everything he saw.
